name: Deflecting Cloud
text:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

Trigger You are the target of a ranged attack.

Requirements You are aware of the attack and currently have dragon wings active.

---

You've mastered a defensive technique unique to the ancient dragons of Bloodsalt: beating your wings to create a billowing cloud of mist. You become momentarily Hidden from the triggering attack if vision is the attacker's only precise sense. Normally this means the attacker must succeed at a DC 11 Flat check check to target you. You also gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.
